title: Secure your apps with App Attest
description: Harness App Attest to protect your app from unauthorized modification and fraud. Uncover how attackers exploit modified apps to spoof data and bypass security checks, and how App Attest defends against these threats. Learn to generate and manage App Attest keys bound to the Secure Enclave, validate attestations and assertions, and use the fraud metric to detect abuse. Discover best practices across all Apple platforms, including new signals in iOS 27 to strengthen your validation.
